issuing_authority.quote: There is created within the Department of Commerce the Division of Professional Licensing. The division shall administer and enforce all licensing laws of Title 58, Occupations and Professions.

exams.quote: passed an examination the commission, with the concurrence of the director, established by rule in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act

exams.name: 25-hour prelicensure course examination
exams.notes: Provider-administered examination at end of 25-hour course; also required: 5-hour business and law course for HVAC contractor applicants.
exams.quote: if the applicant is applying for licensure as a general building contractor, general engineering contractor, residential and small commercial contractor, general plumbing contractor, residential plumbing contractor, general electrical contractor, residential electrical contractor, or HVAC contractor, other than an applicant who completed the 25-hour course described in Subsection (1)(e)(iii) before July 1, 2019, complete a five-hour business and law course

interval_years.quote: Each license issued under this chapter shall be issued in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.

required.quote: Each contractor licensee under a license issued under this chapter shall complete six hours of approved continuing education during each two-year renewal cycle established by rule under Subsection 58-55-303(1).

hours_per_period.quote: Each contractor licensee under a license issued under this chapter shall complete six hours of approved continuing education during each two-year renewal cycle

period_years.quote: during each two-year renewal cycle established by rule under Subsection 58-55-303(1)

value: At least 3 of the 6 hours must be directly related to installation, repair, or replacement of a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system
topical_requirements.quote: For a contractor licensee that is licensed in the specialty contractor classification of HVAC contractor, at least three of the six hours described in Subsection (1) shall include continuing education directly related to the installation, repair, or replacement of a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system.

available.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing

requirements.value: License by endorsement available if out-of-state license covers similar scope of practice, applicant has at least one year of experience, and license is in good standing.
requirements.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing in the other state, district, or territory where the license was issued.

exists.quote: There is created within the division the Construction Services Commission.

credential_type.quote: The division shall issue licenses under this chapter to qualified persons in the following classifications: ... (l) HVAC contractor

is_mandatory.quote: installation, repair, or replacement of a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system (HVAC) on a Subsection (1)(h)(i) project must be performed by an HVAC contractor licensed by the division

title_protection.quote: engaging in a construction trade, acting as a contractor, an alarm business or company, or an alarm company agent, or representing oneself to be engaged in a construction trade or to be acting as a contractor in a construction trade requiring licensure, unless the person doing any of these is appropriately licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: installation, repair, or replacement of a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system (HVAC) on a Subsection (1)(h)(i) project must be performed by an HVAC contractor licensed by the division

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a construction trade or acting as a contractor without being appropriately licensed or exempted.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in a construction trade, acting as a contractor, an alarm business or company, or an alarm company agent, or representing oneself to be engaged in a construction trade or to be acting as a contractor in a construction trade requiring licensure, unless the person doing any of these is appropriately licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a construction trade beyond the scope of the license held.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: acting in a construction trade, as an alarm business or company, or as an alarm company agent beyond the scope of the license held

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hiring or employing a person who is not licensed under this chapter to perform work on a project.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: hiring or employing a person who is not licensed under this chapter to perform work on a project, unless the person: (a) is an employee of a person licensed under this chapter for wages; and (b) is not required to be licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately misrepresenting or omitting a material fact in connection with an application to obtain or renew a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully or deliberately misrepresenting or omitting a material fact in connection with an application to obtain or renew a license under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing one's license to be used by another except as provided by statute or rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: allowing one's license to be used by another except as provided by statute or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Doing business under a name other than the name appearing on the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: doing business under a name other than the name appearing on the license, except as permitted by statute or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving funds for a project and failing to pay persons who performed work or furnished materials within a reasonable period.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: receiving any funds in payment for a specific project from an owner or any other person, which funds are to pay for work performed or materials and services furnished for that specific project, and after receiving the funds to exercise unauthorized control over the funds by failing to pay the full amounts due and payable

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately disregarding or violating building, safety, health, workers' compensation, or other applicable laws.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully or deliberately disregarding or violating: (a) the building or construction laws of this state or any political subdivision; (b) the safety and labor laws applicable to a project; (c) any provision of the health laws applicable to a project; (d) the workers' compensation insurance laws of the state applicable to a project

disciplinary_grounds.description: If licensed as a contractor, not completing the approved continuing education required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor, not completing the approved continuing education required under Section 58-55-302.5

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to establish, maintain, or demonstrate financial responsibility while licensed as a contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to establish, maintain, or demonstrate financial responsibility while licensed as a contractor under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disregarding or violating through gross negligence or a pattern of negligence applicable building, safety, health, or other laws.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: disregarding or violating through gross negligence or a pattern of negligence: (a) the building or construction laws of this state or any political subdivision; (b) the safety and labor laws applicable to a project

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act by a licensee that causes material injury to another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act by a licensee, caused by a licensee, or at a licensee's direction which causes material injury to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with operating standards established by rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to comply with operating standards established by rule in accordance with Section 58-55-308

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to continuously maintain insurance and registration as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to continuously maintain insurance and registration as required under Subsection 58-55-302(2)

bonding_required.quote: submitting a bond in an amount and form determined by the commission with the concurrence of the director

insurance_required.quote: proof of workers' compensation insurance that covers employees of the applicant in accordance with applicable Utah law; (ii) proof of public liability insurance in coverage amounts and form established by rule

definition_quote.value: HVAC contractor means a person licensed under this chapter specialized in the installation, maintenance, repair, and servicing of heating, ventilation, air conditioning systems or any other work the division authorizes by rule in accordance with Subsection 58-55-301(4).
definition_quote.quote: "HVAC contractor" means a person licensed under this chapter specialized in the installation, maintenance, repair, and servicing of heating, ventilation, air conditioning systems or any other work the division authorizes by rule in accordance with Subsection 58-55-301(4).

methods_authorized.quote: specialized in the installation, maintenance, repair, and servicing of heating, ventilation, air conditioning systems

system_components_included.quote: "HVAC" means a heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system and the specific components that are a part of the system, including the gas line.

hvac_specific_experience_required.quote: completed two years full-time paid employment of HVAC specific experience

hvac_specific_experience_years.quote: completed two years full-time paid employment of HVAC specific experience

prelicensure_course_hours.quote: complete a 25-hour course that the commission with the concurrence of the director establishes by rule, that is taught by an approved prelicensure course provider

business_law_course_hours.quote: if the applicant is applying for licensure as a general building contractor, general engineering contractor, residential and small commercial contractor, general plumbing contractor, residential plumbing contractor, general electrical contractor, residential electrical contractor, or HVAC contractor, other than an applicant who completed the 25-hour course described in Subsection (1)(e)(iii) before July 1, 2019, complete a five-hour business and law course

qualifier_required.quote: A person acting as a qualifier for a business entity licensee must demonstrate to the division that the individual is an owner, officer, or manager within that business entity who exercises material authority in the conduct of that business entity's contracting business

qualifier_cessation_notification_days.quote: the licensee shall notify the division in writing within 10 days after cessation of association or employment

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: the license shall remain in force for 60 days after the date of cessation of association or employment. The licensee shall replace the original qualifier with another individual qualifier within the 60-day period or the license shall be automatically suspended.

hvac_continuing_education_topic_hours_mi.quote: at least three of the six hours described in Subsection (1) shall include continuing education directly related to the installation, repair, or replacement of a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system.

gas_appliance_certification_required.quote: Any person described in Subsection (2)(b) that performs work described in Subsection (2)(a): (i) must first receive training and certification as specified in rules adopted by the commission, with the concurrence of the director

natural_gas_facilities_installation_auth.quote: "Qualifying installer" means a person who: (i) a gas corporation approves to install natural gas facilities; and (ii) is: (A) licensed under this chapter; and (B) authorized to install natural gas facilities within the person's scope of practice as established by statute or administrative rule.

value: completing a questionnaire developed by the division and signing it certifying accuracy

financial_responsibility_demonstration_m.quote: demonstrate to the division and the commission the applicant's or licensee's financial responsibility before the issuance of or the renewal or reinstatement of a license by: (a)(i) completing a questionnaire developed by the division; and (ii) signing the questionnaire, certifying that the information provided is true and accurate; or (b) submitting a bond in an amount and form determined by the commission with the concurrence of the director.

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: proof of workers' compensation insurance that covers employees of the applicant in accordance with applicable Utah law

public_liability_insurance_required.quote: proof of public liability insurance in coverage amounts and form established by rule except for a construction trades instructor for whom public liability insurance is not required

small_project_exemption_threshold_dollar.quote: a person engaged in the alteration, repair, remodeling, or addition to or improvement of a building with a contracted or agreed value of less than $7,000, including both labor and materials, and including all changes or additions to the contracted or agreed upon work

hvac_exempt_from_small_project_exemption.quote: installation, repair, or replacement of a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system (HVAC) on a Subsection (1)(h)(i) project must be performed by an HVAC contractor licensed by the division

license_number_on_permits_required.quote: The contractor's license number shall be made a part of all permit applications, contracts, agreements, or bids when a license is required.

scope_expansion_by_rule_authorized.quote: With the concurrence of the director, in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act, the commission may further define the scope of work by rule for: ... (c) an HVAC contractor
